bullets: CAVEAT: this is not a deck. Video time 255.4-615.9 s of "Ryley's BEST Predictions of 2026!" is a highlight montage — the match clock jumps upward at t≈324, 346, 366, 403, 410, 438, 495 and 580 (and again inside the first stretch at t≈270, 284 and 310), so the segment is ~9-11 short clips from different games, each with its own deck and its own opponent. The card list above is the union of everything attributable to Ryley across all of them, not eight cards played together.

deck_key is deliberately null. The engine's per-game HUD read (Ice Spirit / Goblin Barrel / Barbarian Barrel / Electro Spirit / Berserker / The Log / Fire Spirit / Knight) is a blend across clips, hand confidence is 0.526, and no file in knowledge_base/decks shares even five cards with it, so no new deck is claimed.

What is consistent across clips is a method, not a list: call the opponent's next card out loud, then place a spell or a cheap body on the tile that card is about to occupy. He does it with spells (The Log t=322.3/340.3/379.4/484.5, Giant Snowball t=288.3, Fireball t=323.3, Zap t=353.4, Earthquake t=403.4, Vines t=498.5), with cheap bodies (Knight t=261.3, Ice Spirit t=356.4/534.5/556.6, Berserker t=522.5/562.6, Miner t=272.3/346.3/426.4/470.5, Dart Goblin t=591.6) and with buildings (Tesla t=293.3, Cannon t=447.4, Goblin Hut t=413.4).

Two of the clips turn on a prediction that is a decision NOT to play: at t≈405 he cancels a Hog Rider ("he might predict us so I'm not going to go in with the hog") and at t≈276 he keeps a Tornado in hand ("I don't even think we need tornado this away"). Two more turn on counter-predicting the opponent's own prediction (t≈366 "bro, I predicted his prediction"; t≈393-399 "I feel like he's going to predict fireball. Yep").

Loosely, the clips at t=324-403 pilot a Hog 2.6-style cycle shell (Hog Rider, Cannon, Skeletons, Ice Spirit, Ice Golem, Fireball, The Log, Musketeer) and the clips from t=438 on pilot log bait (Goblin Barrel, Princess, Dart Goblin, Skeleton Army, Wall Breakers) — he says so himself at t=451, "this guy hates log bait" — but no one archetype covers the segment, so own_archetype is null.

Only two clips state a result: t=438-495 ends with both enemy towers under 300 HP and "I think it's going to end up getting him three-crowned. GG's, bro", and t=580-615.9 ends on "that is good game... we had to do so many predictions to win that". The segment-level result is unknown.
